name: Structural connectivity & White Matter Classification (WMC) using DIPY
summary: Generate a structural connectivity matrix and a White Matter Classification structure for a given parcellation and tractogram.
description: Reduces the parcellation to the labels actually present, orients the streamlines and builds a region-by-region streamline count matrix with dipy.tracking.utils.connectivity_matrix. Each connected label pair also becomes a named tract in a white matter classification, so streamlines can be inspected per connection. An optional threshold removes connections with fewer streamlines (a fraction of the total when below 1, a count otherwise). The README is an unfilled template; tractogram and parcellation must be in the same space.

inputs.description: Volumetric parcellation with label.json naming each label; labels absent from the volume are dropped.

outputs.description: White matter classification (classification.mat) with one tract per connected pair of parcels.
Streamline-count connectivity matrix in brainlife conmat format (CSV with index and label files).

parameters.description: The threshold to be applied to the connectome generation process.  Numbers less than one will be interpreted as proportion of total input tractogram streamline count, numbers larger than 1 will be interpreted as streamline count.
